The fallback code is present exactly as described. The actor-filtered path is skipped when either `$repo` or `$actor` is empty (covering the triggers: `gh api user` failure with `GITHUB_ACTOR` unset, or `GITHUB_REPOSITORY` unset). It also fires when the actor-filtered path runs but returns no matching comment. In all these cases the fallback query has no `.user.login` filter — any commenter's body is eligible, and the `<!-- zbuild-holder: PAYLOAD -->` from a spoofed comment would be extracted and returned as the holder string.
